title: Block V Pre-execution Protocol Clarification Addendum
reason: Two frozen decision requirements lack a fully specified execution-level operationalization.

H5.1_matched_self_irrelevant_control.problem: The manifest requires matched self-irrelevant controls but the frozen variant file does not define their exact task configuration.
H5.1_matched_self_irrelevant_control.resolution: Use the same held-out seed, external difficulty schedule, latent internal-state generation and primary action task as the corresponding decisive family, but disable the optional confidence-sensitive checking/additional-compute action. The self-monitor is still computed and logged; it has no causal route to alter task action. S1 and S2 therefore differ only in the availability of the active monitor route in the decisive self-relevant condition, not in generic base-task capacity.

H5.6_metric_precedence.problem: The manifest states S2 must exceed bypasses by >=0.10 mean accuracy or utility, leaving metric selection ambiguous.
H5.6_metric_precedence.resolution: Utility is the primary H5.6 bypass metric because both decisive task families include preregistered costs for checking or additional computation. Accuracy is reported as secondary. RETAIN requires >=0.10 mean utility advantage over every bypass in both families with >=18/20 seeds favouring S2. REDUCE applies if H_EXTERNAL is within 0.05 mean utility of S2 in both families and reproduces the downstream control benefit.
H5.6_metric_precedence.rationale: This choice was made before any confirmatory execution and prevents post-outcome selection between accuracy and utility.
